title: (Invited Paper) Overview of 2025 CAD Contest at ICCAD
problem: Electronic design automation research requires engagement between academia and industry with real-world problem statements and benchmarks.
motivation: CAD contests foster productive industry-academia collaboration and research productivity in EDA.
method: Multi-month research competition with problem statements from EDA/IC industry; provides industrial benchmarks and solution evaluators.
key_novelty: Contest format providing real-world EDA problems to research community; annual tradition since 2012.
contributions: State-of-the-art problem statements: hardware trojan detection, multibit flip-flop design optimization, incremental placement

metrics.other: 247 teams, hundreds of publications in top conferences/journals annually

limitations: Invited paper - overview only; not a technical research contribution.
